text:
Rina (docs): drafting a One-Pager Quickstart for Optimize toolkit migration (aim: single-page, pragmatic). plan: 3 tiny snippets (batching policy, kv-prefetch, quant tip), a 3-step checklist, and 2 links (telemetry, rollout). anyone object?
Ben (runtime): sounds good. can we make the batching JSON copy-paste ready for the Dedicated server config? small keys only.
Kofi (opt): add a single-sentence guideline on choosing quant levels. also note typical perf deltas: int8 ~2-5% quality drop but 3-5x throughput.
Nia (pm): product copy: "expected wins: lower p95 latency and lower cost per token; watch short-seq regressions." keep it non-technical.
docbot: PR #9120 created by Rina — "optkit-onepager-snippets". CI: docs-lint OK, linkcheck: 2 broken links.
Rina (docs): ack. Ben, can you paste the kv-prefetch minimal SDK example (3 lines)?
Ben (runtime): use this:```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
res = cli.generate("finish: short summary", prefetch_kv=True)
```
Rina (docs): added. Kofi, what's your 1-liner quant guidance?
Kofi (opt): "Use int8 for bulk batch workloads where throughput dominates; use fp16 (or bf16) for latency-sensitive cases and short inputs. Always run a 50-sample fidelity check on real prompts before promoting."
Rina (docs): perfect. added a short FAQ row: "How to pick batch size?" Answer: "Start with auto dynamic batching; if you see unstable latency, set manual max_batch_tokens and min_requests."
Ben (runtime): paste batching config for server:```json
{
  "batching_policy": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 8192,
    "min_requests": 1,
    "timeout_ms": 25
  }
}
```
Rina (docs): nice. I'll add a note: "If p95 increases, try timeout_ms=10 and reduce max_batch_tokens." Also adding SDK streaming auth tip: include `Accept: text/event-stream` header for SSE clients.
Nia (pm): add a rollback sentence: "Promote previous model variant in Console > Deployments > Routes to revert."
Rina (docs): okay. docbot flagged two broken links: which ones?
docbot: linkcheck report — broken: /old-prefetch, /telemetry-v1.
Ben (runtime): canonical kv prefetch page is https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/kv-prefetch — update it. telemetry canonical is https://docs.redwood.ai/console/telemetry-guide.
Rina (docs): updated links in PR. re-running linkcheck...
docbot: linkcheck re-run passing. PR #9120 merged. :tada:
Kofi (opt): quick follow-up — please include a tiny line recommending "smoke eval" before rollouts (5-20 prompts).
Rina (docs): added smoke eval bullet to checklist. final pass: @Ben confirm snippets, @Kofi confirm quant sentence, @Nia confirm product copy. aiming to close thread.
Ben (runtime): snippets + links verified.
Kofi (opt): quant line good.
Nia (pm): copy ok. thanks all. :shipit:
